body:
Your word (in Model movements): "only expressions are good; model should be only one, except colour differences."
So: ONE body (Real, game style) with colour variants only.
Sleepy, smile and blush, yawn, tilt, chin down, happy, curious, lying = faces on that one body, not separate models.
The cute set is not a second capybara.
Next build: the Capybara card shows one body + a face picker; no body versions to pick.

comments.text: Real: lower rump, cuter eyes, nose-to-mouth line. 4 versions from it.
Sleepy family: 4 new versions like Sleepy. Critic: tilted 8, lying chin down 8, others 6-7.

Changed: one body + faces, no body versions.
Card update sent to the building chat (Plan).
Built: one body. Face picker: Calm, Sleepy, Sleepy smile and blush, Yawning, Happy, Curious, Sauna zen (steam puffs + rosy cheeks). Age and Colour pickers stay.
Approved: you decided it in Model Compare (31 Oct).

short: One capybara body + 7 faces (Sauna zen added). Pick in Model Compare
